method.fully_financed_economic_earnings_fy2027: normalized operating income x (1 - tax) - fin_cost x max(funding_gap, 0)
method.funding_gap: capex (Meta: including finance-lease principal) - (NOPAT + depreciation); depreciation is deducted in earnings once and capex enters only via the gap's carrying cost
method.stock_compensation: GAAP expense kept; employee share issuance not added to units (avoids double counting)
method.fin_cost_rationale: about the after-tax cost of new debt and close to the earnings yield of new stock at current prices (META 4.95%), so the unverified debt/equity/preferred mix moves EPS by under 0.5%
method.value_per_unit: justified_pe x FFE_EPS + (net cash at 2026-12-31E + after-tax investment assets - other claims) / units

parameters.r_basis: 10-year Treasury 4.98% + assumed equity premium 4.5%, beta about 1

method.implied_growth: g solving justified_pe(r, g) = (price - per-unit adjustments) / FFE_EPS
method.twelve_month_expectation: expected relative return = 0.25 x (base value / price - 1); P(outperform) = Phi(expected / 0.27)
